subject.title: Feature: Project trees + threaded entry points in Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw core add first-class project/thread organization to Control UI now, and what Gateway/session transcript semantics should route targets, split/move, and seed-copy expose?
rationale: The request spans user-facing project organization, persistent session metadata, transcript mutation or copy semantics, and Gateway protocol shape, so automation cannot safely choose the long-lived product contract.

options.title: Define core product/API first
options.body: Keep this open while maintainers specify project/thread metadata, tree UI, route-target or fanout payloads, and split/copy transcript semantics before implementation.

options.title: Narrow to session organization
options.body: Limit near-term work to labels, search, pinning, archiving, and grouping over existing sessions without transcript mutation or composer fanout.

options.title: Defer broader workflow
options.body: Rely on current session management, reply display, and checkpoint branching until stronger demand or a narrower API proposal appears.

recommendation.title: Define core product/API first
recommendation.body: Keep this open while maintainers specify project/thread metadata, tree UI, route-target or fanout payloads, and split/copy transcript semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already provided the prior keep-open routing signal and authored the adjacent session-management work that partially overlaps this request.
